messages:
anna: Kicking off the cross-region rollout window now — US then EU then APAC. Deploybot scheduled at 13:30 UTC. Need final capacity + pin plan and rollback thresholds. @mike @tara

mike: US warm pool smoke looks good. 1200 concurrent slots, avg utilization 62% with expected surge headroom ~25%. Recommending pin v2.4.1 for US slice.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] queued run 6282024200: --slice us --version v2.4.1 --strategy phased --notify #eng-releases

tara: quick note — EU infra has maintenance window at 15:00 UTC (network patch). Can we shift EU rollout to 15:30 UTC to avoid overlap?

anna: yes shift EU to 15:30. keep APAC at 20:00 UTC. update run parameters and call out rollback triggers in release notes.

mike: smoke test commands for ops: ```
# run smoke against canary
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":"smoke"}'
# check kv cache pressure
redis-cli info memory | grep used_memory_human
```

kai: saw an APAC staging node eviction earlier today — eviction rate 0.4% but OOM logs spike for long prompts. Suggest we enable memory-safety flag for APAC canary: `--mem-safety=on` and limit max_seq=2048 for canary slice.

anna: good catch. set mem-safety on for APAC canary. keep US/EU default for now. Add to notes: if OOMs > 0.5% during canary -> immediate rollback for that slice.

sre_bot: [metric-alert suppressed] p95_latency_us_canary=382ms, error_rate_us_canary=0.12% — within thresholds.

mike: proposed rollback triggers (vote): error_rate > 1% sustained for 5m, p95 latency increase > 50% baseline for 3m, OOMs > 0.5% in canary. agree? :thumbsup: :thumbsdown: 

tara: +1 on those. Also add data-regression: top-k hallucination rate increase > 3% on eval set = manual rollback review.

anna: locking in: US v2.4.1 pinned for 1h after successful canary at 25% traffic. EU will follow at 15:30 UTC pinned to v2.4.1 but with reduced concurrency (60%) for first 20m. APAC at 20:00 with mem-safety.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] starting canary for us slice at 13:30 UTC. commands: `deploybot run --slice us --version v2.4.1 --canary=25% --pin-duration=1h`

mike: running capacity smoke now. attaching quick result: `conns=1180/1200, avg_cpu=34%, avg_gpu_mem=48%` — heatmap good.

sre_bot: [log] event: us_canary_start ts=6282024250

kai: monitoring KV hit-rate — prefix cache warmed to 86%. Good for latency savings.

tara: EU holdpoint at 15:25 UTC. i'll do manual check: infra, latency, error budget, and customers in EU list.

anna: decision matrix reminder in release notes: if US canary passes > 10m stable with no triggers -> proceed EU. If any trigger fires -> pin hold + rollback US to v2.4.0 and notify stakeholders.

mike: small ops note: rollback command if needed: `deploybot rollback --slice us --to-version v2.4.0 --reason "canary regressions"` — we should pre-stage that in runbook.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] canary snapshot: samples ok, streaming responses working. Awaiting 15m stable window.

anna: heading to follow the 10m check then will post final go/no-go. thanks all. :white_check_mark:

kai: will keep eye on OOMs and cache pressure, will ping if >0.2% spike.

sre_bot: [log] event: us_canary_10min_stable ts=6282024320

anna: GO for EU at 15:30 UTC. I'll update release notes and pinboard.

mike: copying run command for EU: `deploybot run --slice eu --version v2.4.1 --concurrency-cap 60% --canary=20% --pin-duration=1h`

tara: prepping customer comms for EU customers in case of rollback.

anna: if EU hits any threshold, immediate freeze and discuss rollback. APAC remains scheduled but mem-safety on for canary. thanks everyone — closing thread after EU handoff.
